sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents illicit card transaction activity identified on customer account C10434 involving payment card C10434-K1. On 2016-12-02, transaction 3506725 totaling $1000.03 was executed via the online channel. Investigation by automated graph intelligence matched the activity to pattern 'card_not_present_new_device' with a fraud confidence of 0.88. Connected entity analysis resolved device fingerprint 'Windows|Windows 10|edge 16.0|1366x768', which has been associated with multi-account transaction clusters across 208 customer profiles. The transaction volume significantly deviated from established baseline expenditure thresholds. In accordance with Bank Fraud Policy Rule R6 and BSA/AML Suspicious Activity Reporting mandates, internal controls initiated card containment, and this matter is escalated for regulatory filing.
